exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "To continue doing".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb + 続ける matches "To continue doing".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb + 続ける.
exercises.explanation: Expresses the ongoing continuation of an action using "verb + tsuzukeru."
